purpose: Add SOURCE LOCK / MAX PRESERVE and TOP-DOWN / BIRD'S-EYE panorama presets while retaining v0.8 organization and v0.6 durable-storage behavior.

source_lock_max_preserve.purpose: Prioritize fidelity to the observed P9 source over beautification or reinterpretation.

top_down_birds_eye.purpose: Preserve a downward-facing / bird's-eye source interpretation without forcing a conventional eye-level horizon.
top_down_birds_eye.horizon_policy: Do not require or invent an eye-level horizon when the accepted P9 camera/source does not show one.

authority.p9: source image + accepted camera/FOV + known geometry
authority.cg03: fail-closed source-camera reprojection + ERP seam validation
